chapter: Howard McGhee's band and bebop in LA
title: Backing Wynonie Harris on 'Around The Clock'
summary: The McGhee band backed Wynonie Harris on his first hit, with a solo by Edwards.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: But during this period, we also made a very big record for the same company. In fact, we had their first hit. We backed Wynonie Harris, the Blues singer, on his first big hit, "Around The Clock." Remember "Around The Clock?" where it talked about when the clock struck one what happened, when it struck two -- he goes all the way through to 12 o'clock, you know, talking about what happened when the clock struck these different hours. And that was his first big hit, and I had a solo on that record.
Did you play that around town a lot?
Well, no, not really. That particular song I didn't play around town, because it was really a vocal thing.
Smokey Lynn(?) used to do that.
